items.t: Stem (STEM) Stock Fair Value Moves Lower As Analysts Weigh Financing And Going Concern Risks
items.sum: Stem’s fair value estimate has been revised from US$6.25 to US$5.16, signaling a reset in how analysts are framing the stock today. This shift aligns with a mixed research backdrop, where stronger margins and software execution are weighed against softer revenue, tighter financing, and the new going concern disclosure.
